local_execution.meaning: Ten finite named unit methods; not ten full Commander gameplay trials or ten separate blueprint cases

cases_implemented_here.specific_result: Exact canonical 100 and commander/throne/pirate source presence; distinct-turn source-payable lands including Ancient Tomb life cost; three unique Pirates damage one player, two targeted end-step thefts if two legal objects; one-target and next-turn reset counterexamples.
cases_implemented_here.limitation: Does not model randomized opening hand, the entire priority system, or actual opposing play frequency.

cases_implemented_here.specific_result: All six current Oracle identities and separate setup costs; Kindred entry/attack draws, Bident per-hit draws, Malcolm per-opponent Treasure, Breeches and Ramirez separate physical exile/mana permissions, Lannery attack Treasure and sacrifice power; Fog prevents hit outputs but not attack outputs.
cases_implemented_here.limitation: Supported named effect subset with staged 20-card own and 8-card opposing libraries; not a full 99-card game trajectory or complete opponents' spellcasting rules.

cases_implemented_here.specific_result: Source-costed five-piece Pirate board and Beckett/Corsair anthems: 3+4+3 real damage per clean combat yields a conditional 40-life elimination across four combats, with blocked-third-source, Fog and end-step removal negatives.
cases_implemented_here.limitation: A conditional finite line under no interaction is not a measured win-rate, a guaranteed turn, or proof that four uninterrupted combats commonly occur.

cases_implemented_here.specific_result: Toxic Deluge paid {2}{B}+X life kills own and enemy Pirates symmetrically; Admiral Brass reanimates only one Pirate with a 4/4 finality counter and later exile instead of repeat death; Daring Piracy creates only timed hasty token; Fathom Fleet's paid {2} token does not join the current attack.
cases_implemented_here.limitation: Representative symmetric wipe and timed recovery only, not every board-wipe effect, replacement effect, or opponent's sequencing.
